adjudication.rationale: The diff does contain `open(url).read` in `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, but the claimed `|`-prefixed command execution path is not verifiable here because the code paths constrain/validate the URL via `URI(...)`: `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` does `URI(@embed_url).host` (rescues `URI::InvalidURIError` and treats it as invalid), and `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` also parses the referer host with `URI(...)`. A string starting with `|` would not have a valid URI host and would be rejected before reaching `open`. Thus the specific “no scheme/pipe check so `|` executes shell command” claim does not match what this diff shows.
